pages.text: Reads the block at a position.

You get its ID, its block state properties as text, the redstone power it receives, whether it has an inventory, and its data. An unloaded chunk raises CHUNK_NOT_LOADED. An empty $(1)dimension$() in the position means the dimension of the trigger block.

The data is what a chest, sign or furnace keeps besides its block states: the items, the text, the custom name. It is SNBT, the text of the commands $(1)/data$() and $(1)/setblock$(), e.g. $(1){Items:[{Slot:0b,count:12,id:"minecraft:cobblestone"}]}$(), without the position. Blocks without such data have $(1)""$(). PLACE_BLOCK can place a block with it.

$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the block is$(li)result $(1)id$() STRING: the block ID, e.g. minecraft:oak_door$(li)result $(1)properties$() HASH STRING: the block states, e.g. facing is north$(li)result $(1)power$() INTEGER: the redstone power it receives, 0 to 15$(li)result $(1)has_inventory$() BOOLEAN: true for blocks with an inventory, such as chests; GET_INVENTORY, MOVE_ITEMS and DELETE_ITEMS work with them$(li)result $(1)data$() STRING: the data of the block as SNBT, or $(1)""$()
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/GET_BLOCK$(br)  PARAMETER position spot ;$(br)  RESULT id blockId$(br)  RESULT properties states$(br)  RESULT power power$(br)  RESULT has_inventory isChest$()
